name: Meet Me at Midnight
source: It's spring break! Your tour of New Orleans with Macy has proved pretty tame thus far. Maybe a toast with a murdered specter and a trip back to the roaring 20's will shake things up...
translation: 春假到了！到目前为止，你和梅西百货的新奥尔良之旅已经被证明相当平淡。也许与被谋杀的幽灵干杯并回到咆哮的20年代会让事情发生翻天覆地的变化……
